name: Triumph Trident T150
engine: 740 cc air-cooled OHV triple, three carbs, points ignition
intro: Triumph's 1969 triple. Clean carbs and points, and a clutch that fully releases, make it a good bike.

add.title: Set up the clutch release
add.instructions: Adjust the clutch so it fully releases. Check the clutch bearing.
add.reason: A clutch that doesn't fully release makes neutral hard to find, a common Trident problem.

E: Early T150s are four-speed. The T150V from 1972 is five-speed, and a front disc came in 1973.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Neutral
known.what: It is a common Trident problem to struggle to find neutral when the clutch doesn't fully release.
